svg.title: Chronological training, validation and test partitions
svg.desc: Train: 1990-03-28 through 2007-05-04; Validation: 2007-05-09 through 2013-01-18; Test: 2013-01-24 through 2018-10-08. Two sessions are purged at each partition boundary. Normalization is fitted on training data and reused unchanged. Dates are positioned on a proportional calendar scale.
